title: Hermes Loop Diagnostics v1
description: Machine-readable contract for the loop-diagnostics subsystem: action-graph trace events emitted by the graph recorder and diagnosis results produced by the diagnosis engine. Bounded to failure diagnosis of Kanban worker runs; this is NOT a general observability schema. See docs/loop-diagnostics-design.md.

Union root: every trace record and every diagnosis result is exactly one of the six kinds below. Each kind declares its own additionalProperties:false surface. An unknown kind fails all branches and is rejected by validation.

ActionStatus.description: Observer-grade lifecycle outcome for a single action. Mirrors docs/observability/README.md status vocabulary: ok | error | blocked | cancelled, plus unknown for incomplete traces.

ActionKind.description: Broad classifier for an action node. MVP records tool_call and loop_iteration; the rest are reserved extension kinds.

InterventionKind.description: Targeted intervention categories from the AgentTether paper, mapped to actionable recommendations. The MVP RECOMMENDS interventions; it never executes them.

FailureCategory.description: Canonical failure taxonomy the diagnosis engine can return. See docs/loop-diagnostics-design.md §Failure categories.

DiagnosisStatus.description: Engine-level confidence envelope. root_cause_found = single deterministic root cause; candidates = ranked set; unknown = no evidence; malformed_trace = trace unreadable.

attempt.description: 1-based attempt ordinal for the task across all runs.

goal_mode.description: True when the worker ran under HERMES_KANBAN_GOAL_MODE.

error.description: Redacted one-line run error when present.

event_count.description: Number of trace events written for this run (excluding header/footer).

action_id.description: Globally stable per-action id. Format: '<run_id>:<seq>' where seq is a monotonic counter within the run. Never reused across runs.

parent_action_id.description: action_id of the action that spawned this one (subagent, nested loop). Null for top-level actions.

loop_id.description: Stable id of the loop instance this action belongs to, e.g. 'retry', 'goal', 'search', or '<parent_action_id>:loop'. Null for non-loop actions. Two actions belong to the same loop instance iff they share loop_id AND iteration differs.

iteration.description: 0-based ordinal within the loop_id instance. Null for non-loop actions. Repeated loop actions MUST NOT conflate iterations: each iteration of the same loop_id increments this.

tool_name.description: Tool name when action_kind == tool_call, e.g. 'terminal', 'web_search', 'kanban_comment'. Null otherwise.

summary.description: Redacted, truncated human-readable summary of what the action is doing. NEVER raw tool args, prompts, file contents, or results. Cap: 512 chars at write time.

api_request_id.description: Opaque provider-attempt id when available. Do not parse.

tool_call_id.description: Provider-supplied tool call id when available.

summary.description: Redacted, truncated result summary. NEVER raw tool results, file contents, or prompts. Cap: 512 chars at write time.

error_type.description: Exception class or error code, e.g. 'ToolExecutionError', 'ExitCodeError', 'TimeoutError'. Cap: 128 chars.

error_message.description: Redacted, truncated error message. Cap: 1024 chars at write time.

result_hash.description: SHA-256 of the redacted result text (hex). Lets the engine detect repeated identical failures WITHOUT storing the result body. Redacted inputs hash deterministically so equivalent traces hash identically.

from_action_id.description: Producer action. For data edges, the action whose output feeds to_action. For causal edges, the action that caused to_action to run.

edge_kind.description: data: from's output is consumed by to (missing/invalid from-input propagation). causal: to ran because from completed. loop: to is the next iteration of the same loop as from. retry: to is a retry of from after a failure.

action_id.description: The action the intervention targets (root cause or safe checkpoint).

rationale.description: One-sentence, deterministic explanation of why this intervention applies. Cap: 512 chars.

payload.description: Optional machine-readable payload, e.g. {"checkpoint_action_id": "..."} for retry_from_checkpoint or {"tool_name": "..."} for alternative_tool. Contents are contract-specific and additive.

PropagationPath.description: Ordered action_id chain from the failed action back to the root cause, starting at the failed action and ending at the root cause action.

root_cause_action_ids.description: Deterministic earliest actionable failure(s). Empty when status is unknown or malformed_trace.

confidence.description: Engine confidence. root_cause_found with a single unambiguous predecessor chain scores >= 0.8; candidates are ranked 0.1-0.7; unknown/malformed_trace score 0.0.

explanation.description: Concise deterministic explanation: what failed, why this is the root cause, and what evidence supports it. Cap: 2048 chars.

interventions.description: Ranked recommendations. At least one entry unless status is unknown/malformed_trace, in which case this may be empty.

failed_action_id.description: The action the diagnosis was requested for.

missing_action_ends.description: action_ids with action_start but no action_end — evidence of cancellation or process death.

malformed_lines.description: Line numbers of trace events that failed schema validation and were skipped.

duplicate_hashes.description: result_hash values seen on 2+ failed actions in the same loop — evidence for loop_repeated.
